description: 3-stage OS command injection via ImageMagick fallback: (1) add image-size metadata extraction for uploaded files using pure Node.js, (2) add sharp-based thumbnail generation on upload, (3) prescriptive bug fix — sharp fails on HEIC/TIFF, fallback to execSync(`convert "${inputPath}" ...`) with user-controlled filename. The filename flows unsanitized into a shell command, enabling arbitrary command execution via crafted filenames.
